summary: Iter 186 frontend testing (test@test.com, premium=true / FREE tier). Verified dashboard section order+content, sidebar labels + badge, was-ist-was page, /tasks not locked, level color light/dark on /profile, /kurse intro + course-access, admin credit-support-card + poster-health, and public /leadership-programm + /coaching redirect. Coach example + input navigate to /chat with ?prefill=. Own-task create + toast + appears on /tasks. About-you save shows toast; skip hides section. Blockers encountered during automation (cookie banner + usage-feedback prompt overlapping form buttons) were dismissed via localStorage keys. video-access-hint on /missions could not be verified for FREE user (paywall modal blocks entry), chat credit-cost-hint hidden for premium=true account, credits-exhausted-dialog + fresh-signup 402 flows and video/audio pause behavior not executed (out of budget / require additional accounts).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful save, on hard page reload the 'Über dich' section briefly re-appears even though /api/profile/me AND /api/dashboard/bootstrap both return position/team_size/current_goal populated. Reproduction: clear profile → dashboard shows about-you → save (toast success) → reload → section still queryable. Root cause probably stale bundle cache or aboutComplete evaluated before ud hydration. Path: /app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.js:124 (aboutComplete uses `data?.user` but the initial render before loadDashboard resolves shows section=visible; likely fine because loading spinner covers it, but tester observed section rendered after loading finished on 1 run of 2). Consider persisting `leaderos_about_you_skipped='1'` on save too as belt+braces.

ui_bugs.component: Automation UX overlays (not a product bug, but affects testability)
ui_bugs.issue: Cookie consent banner (lo_consent_v1) AND UsageFeedbackPrompt (leaderos:usage-feedback-done) cover the bottom-right corner where 'home-coach-send-btn' at (x=1487,y=752) and 'home-task-create-btn' at (x=1482,y=1340) sit. Automated tests must set both localStorage keys or dismiss the overlays. The support widget also overlaps the input row for Frag deinen Coach. Consider stacking-context / z-index adjustments so support widget does not cover primary CTA row on the dashboard.

Navigating directly to /my-path landed in dark mode automatically (document.documentElement.dark=true), while /profile landed in light mode. Behaviour inconsistency between the two pages of the same account — not a critical color bug (dark mode neon rgb(191,255,0) is correct there) but worth aligning both to the user's chosen theme.

integration_issues.issue: test@test.com (FREE tier) sees the 'Video-Analyse ist exklusiv in Leadership OS PLUS' paywall modal directly on entry, so the RecordingStudio and its 'video-access-hint' never render. Cannot verify the requested hint without an Accelerator/PLUS account. Use accelerator@wladbot.test to complete this check.

Not executed — requires fresh signup + credit exhaustion + intercepting {error:'no_credits'} 402. Deferred; needs targeted E2E fixture.

action_items: Confirm About-you section stays hidden after save+reload — may need to persist skip flag on save too (path: /app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.js:124/194).
Verify video-access-hint copy using accelerator@wladbot.test on /missions RecordingStudio.
Run credit-cost-hint-chat + credits-exhausted-dialog + tier_required flow with a fresh FREE-signup or by stubbing 402 responses (network intercept in Playwright).
Add pause-on-nav + pause-on-drawer/voice-mode assertions for GuideVideoPlayer via a dedicated harness that uses video.play() programmatically (headless has no H.264).
Consider z-index tweak so UsageFeedbackPrompt does not overlap the 'Frag deinen Coach' input row on dashboard (impacts UX for logged-in users after 30 AI interactions, not just testability).
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.js:194 — onSaved only sets local aboutDone=true; on hard reload the initial render before dashboard-v4 fetches will briefly display about-you unless ud already has the fields at first paint. Persisting leaderos_about_you_skipped='1' on save avoids the flash and is cheap belt-and-braces.

UsageFeedbackPrompt overlaps primary CTAs on dashboard at 1920x900 (right column intrudes ~300px, causing button clicks to miss when not force=True). Move prompt to bottom-left or hide during first N seconds of dashboard.

dashboardBootstrap.js has an in-module bundle cache with 15s TTL — after a PATCH /profile the reload can still hit the fresh backend but if a user quickly opens two dashboard tabs the second reads stale bundle for ≤15s. Consider clearing the bundle in api interceptor on profile PATCH success.
test_credentials: test@test.com / test123 (used for all logged-in tests). Admin flag on same account. accelerator@wladbot.test / test123 required for /missions video hint. Fresh signup required for credits-exhausted dialog.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed tasks + profile fields (position=Teamleiter, team_size=8, current_goal=Bessere Meetings) were created on user_f111693f1b00. Cleaned tasks via API but profile fields remain populated after final run — main agent may want to reset for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Before any Playwright automation, set these localStorage keys after page load and before clicking form buttons: leaderos_tour_v1_done=1, leaderos_welcome_seen=1, leaderos:usage-feedback-done=1, lo_consent_v1={v:1,ts:ISO,essential:true,analytics:true,replays:true}. Otherwise cookie banner + usage-feedback + dashboard-first-tour will block/overlap dashboard CTA buttons. Use accelerator@wladbot.test for RecordingStudio + video-access-hint verification and a freshly-created FREE account for credit-cost-hint + credits-exhausted-dialog flows.
rca of the issue: Coach-send / task-create / about-save all worked once overlays were dismissed via localStorage. About-you re-appearance after reload correlated with the initial render happening before /api/dashboard/bootstrap resolved — mitigation: persist skip flag on save.
